title: POST /books returns 200 instead of 201 Created
evidence: main.py:62-81 create_book returns default 200; no status_code=201 on the route decorator
suggestion: Add status_code=201 to @app.post("/books") for a more appropriate created code

title: Missing-field validation surfaces as 422, not the 400 the tests assert
evidence: models.py:16-20 BookCreate marks title/author required, so a wholly missing field is rejected by pydantic with 422 before main.py:66-69; empty-string is the only path that hits the manual 400
suggestion: Either assert 422 in test_create_book_validation_errors or make title/author Optional and rely solely on the manual 400 check for consistent behavior

title: New SQLite connection opened and closed on every request
evidence: database.py:7-11 get_db_connection called per handler in main.py; no pooling
suggestion: Acceptable for this task; consider a connection dependency for higher throughput

title: No requirements.txt / pyproject.toml pinning deps
evidence: run_dir has no requirements.txt; README.md documents `pip install fastapi uvicorn` inline instead
suggestion: Add a requirements.txt for reproducible installs (not required by the task spec)
